Package com.csse3200.game.components.loot

Class ConsumableItem

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.components.loot.Item
com.csse3200.game.components.loot.ConsumableItem
public class ConsumableItem extends Item
Represents a consumable item that can be stored in the player's inventory and used for an immediate effect.

A consumable has the common properties of an Item, plus a ConsumableType and the ConsumableEffect it applies when used. Following WeaponItem, this stays a plain data class: the use handler lives in ConsumableUseComponent on the player entity.

    • use

      public boolean use(Entity entity)
      Applies this consumable's effect to the given entity.

      Returning false means the item had no effect and must not be consumed, for example a health potion used at full health.

      Parameters:
      entity - entity using the item
      Returns:
      true if the effect was applied
